AN322
Religion, Ritual and Magic
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
The study of ritual performances which relate society to the divine, with a focus on the collective production of meaning. Topics may include: rites of passage, spirit possession, magical beliefs, and the social and epistemological dimensions of religious systems.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
